meta.title: Meridian — Global financial routing
meta.description: Non-custodial routing hub for businesses and AI agents: compare traditional finance, stablecoin and wholesale liquidity routes. Meridian never holds funds or keys and does not execute, settle, or custody funds.

landing.title: Rank payment routes for businesses and AI agents
landing.lede: Meridian is a non-custodial comparison layer for businesses and AI agents. It compares traditional finance, stablecoin and wholesale liquidity routes, then reports all-in cost, fees, settlement time, slippage and a route score — without taking custody or moving funds. Quotes stay sandbox-labelled until a licensed partner is connected. Execution is not in this product. Meridian does not execute or delegate settlement.

footer.landingNotice: Meridian is non-custodial. It compares routes and never holds customer funds, private keys or wallets, never acts as principal, and does not execute or delegate settlement yet. Quotes are indicative and non-binding; transact directly with the provider you choose.
